title: Porch shoe storage and bench
summary: A porch fitted with a tall shoe cupboard, open shoe shelves and a bench seat.
intro: An entrance porch turned into proper storage: a tall cupboard with panelled doors, open shelves for everyday shoes and a bench to sit on while you take them off.

cover.alt: Porch with a tall panelled cupboard and a bench seat

gallery.alt: Porch storage from the front door

poster.alt: 3D SketchUp model of the porch: a tall two-door cupboard on one side, a shoe cupboard and a bench with boarded wall on the other

model3d.title: The SketchUp model in 3D
model3d.text: The porch drawn in SketchUp from the photos, at standard sizes rather than measured ones. Open the doors to see the shelves and the rows of shoe shelves, or take it apart to see each board.
